title: chore(examples): add e-commerce widgets [part 1]
body:
*This is part 1 of the series "e-commerce demo".*

## Description

This PR scaffolds the e-commerce demo with InstantSearch.js widgets. It was generated using [Create InstantSearch App](https://github.com/algolia/create-instantsearch-app).

## Notes

* Everything in the demo was achieved without connectors
* `algoliasearch` and `instantsearch.js` deps are added as dependencies to trigger less network requests (not loading from a CDN) and to leverage Renovate
* The ES build of `instantsearch.js` is used
* It doesn't include voice search because the designs are not done yet

## Preview

There's currently no styles in this part 1.

[See preview →](https://deploy-preview-3799--instantsearchjs.netlify.com/examples/e-commerce/)

## Related

* [E-commerce demo design](https://app.zeplin.io/project/5acc8becfc0c980068fc12cc/screen/5cd1a7992e4f02039b5a8336)
